open.said: This is the call for the week of October 30 to November 5. It read both repositories as they stood on Thursday night, and these are sample words: the real call is written each week from that week's record.

board.said: Twenty-two items are open on the ledger, and every one of them has something waiting on you. Most of those are small calls. Three of them hold up work an agent could start today.

rows.title: My Studio: a video I make in sittings, on the phone
Shows in Studio: an episode is its format plus the week's data
My data: see what I keep, and delete what I choose
Every promise about outcomes and work, on one page
some-ui: each shared concern has one owner and a guard

moved.said: Studio moved to the new model this week. Takes are a library on home, searchable by meaning, and a finished episode goes home as its DNA. Nothing renders it yet.
next: The routine that fills a queued video
The weekly call as the first template

moved.said: My data is switched on for Studio's recordings. You can delete a take for good, and each delete leaves a receipt. It shows once home runs the new image.
next: A take in a published video becomes deletable

changesets/action v2 for CLI v3, with npm auth

gray.title: Release actions are paired with their CLI
gray.said: A new promise, CS1: the changesets action and its command line move together, and the workflow check holds them as a pair.

mine.title: Home refuses a DNA with any field it doesn't name
mine.said: Without asking you, home was made to refuse a video's DNA that has a field it doesn't know, rather than keep it and ignore the field.
options: Keep it and ignore the field
mine.why: A field home ignores would be lost when the video is made again, and the DNA has to be enough on its own.
mine.undo: Loosen the schema on both sides in one change; nothing kept depends on the refusal.

asks.question: Redeploy home with the server's latest image?
asks.said: First, home runs an older server build. Until it's redeployed, My data, the take library and queued videos don't work against it.
asks.whyYours: Only you can reach the box.

options.unblocks: My data, the take library and queued videos on home
Nothing yet; the phone keeps copies until then

asks.question: Who answers between turns of a conversation?
asks.said: Second, TALK's first decision: between your turns, does a live model answer, or a scripted one?
asks.whyYours: It decides what the conversation is: a product call, not a code one.

close.said: That's the week. Two asks were voiced and one is on the list. Your answers start the next sessions.
